CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
|-- Public history boundary
|   |-- CanvasEditingContext { readonly contextId: string }
|   |-- Handles and services are runtime-only; saved canvases carry records
|   |-- CanvasContextState: checkpointId, document, view, canUndo, canRedo
|   |-- openContext(document, view, history?); state(context); document(context)
|   |-- resolve(context, diagramId): DiagramView
|   |-- Controllers coordinate edits; this service manages history and its storage
|   |-- append(context, document, view, correspondence?); navigate(context, redo?)
|   `-- Navigation rejects linked transfers that require workspace undo/redo
|-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService implementation
|   |-- private contexts: WeakMap<CanvasEditingContext, CanvasHistory>
|   |-- openContext -> new CanvasHistory(...) -> freeze handle -> contexts.set [calls]
|   |-- Object handles isolate viewers of one persisted context and permit collection
|   |-- private history(context) rejects unknown handles
|   |-- resolve -> history.diagrams.resolve(history.contextId, diagramId) [call]
|   `-- state reads the head checkpoint and history navigation capabilities
|-- Portable history and transfer adapters
|   |-- exportContext(context); persistenceChanges(context, since?)
|   |-- Callers use records/deltas without interpreting diagram revision tables
|   |-- forkContext(context, view); adopt(context, proposed); reset(context)
|   |-- retireTransactions(context, ids) delegates link retirement to history
|   |-- prepareTransfer -> prepareCanvasTransfer(exported histories, input) [call]
|   |-- transferBoundary <- history.headId, transaction, canvasId, redo [data]
|   `-- prepareTransferNavigation requires both exported participant histories
|-- Workspace coordination in MappingPage
|   |-- transfer -> runWorkspaceTask({ type: 'transfer', ... }) [call]
|   |-- The page prepares source/destination records and a workspace transaction
|   |-- undo -> source.prepareTransferNavigation(destination, tx, redo) [call]
|   |-- Newer transfers involving either participant must be undone first
|   |-- publishTransfer -> storage.save -> installWorkspace [awaited call order]
|   `-- Both histories and the transfer are persisted before UI installation
|-- WorkspacePersistence record adapter
|   |-- sync(ids) -> controller.persistenceChanges(cursor) -> historyChanges(id, delta)
|   |-- The adapter translates live owners into records and manages per-session cursors
|   |-- sync <- metadata, baseline, history delta, display, viewport [data]
|   |-- Replaced sessions remove obsolete revision/checkpoint records in the same batch
|   |-- sync / syncView -> view.captureDisplay, view.captureCamera, storage.batch [calls]
|   |-- update(activeDocumentId, transfers) writes the workspace index unless paused
|   `-- dispose unsubscribes workspace and view listeners
|-- RecordStorage cache and transport boundary
|   |-- batch(changes); store(key, value); remove(key); get(key); keys()
|   |-- It manages cache entries, pending changes, one flight, timers and listeners
|   |-- pump -> transport.write({ requestId, expectedRevision, changes }) [call]
|   |-- An ambiguous failure retains the identical request for retry
|   |-- flush(): Promise<void>; commit(changes): Promise<void>
|   |-- Explicit commit restores the prior cache on definitive REJECTED failure
|   `-- dispose clears timers/listeners; callers must flush before orderly close
`-- WorkspaceStorage worker adapter
    |-- load() -> request({ type: 'load' }) -> new RecordStorage(state, transport)
    |-- It creates and terminates a workspace worker and manages pending requests
    |-- request -> worker.postMessage; worker.onmessage -> resolve | reject [calls]
    |-- save(snapshot) -> load -> records.flush -> project -> records.commit [calls]
    |-- restore flushes and disposes records before reloading
    `-- dispose also rejects pending worker requests
